title: LATER: Learning Action-Conditioned Temporal Evidence Retrieval for Predictive World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25671v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Early interactions can reveal physical properties that later observations no longer show. These properties can still gov- ern the effects of future actions. Inspired by the distinction between retention and selective readout in working mem- ory and cognitive science, we introduce LATER, an action- conditioned world model built on CF-JEPA. LATER stores completed real transitions in partitioned memories that remain fixed during candidate rollouts. A response bridge queries these memories using the current state and candidate action, while multi-cut auxiliary supervision trains the memory writ- ers. On distracted Two-Stage PushT, LATER raises terminal success from 15.5% to 25.0% over reconstructed CF-JEPA. In a separate comparison across six models and two scratch- training seeds, LATER achieves the lowest mean physical readout error in both clean and distracted views, reducing along-push mean absolute error (MAE) under distractors by 20.2%

translated_title: LATER：面向预测性世界模型的动作条件时序证据检索学习
translated_abstract: 早期的交互可以揭示后续观察不再能显示的物理属性，而这些属性仍然能够支配未来动作的效果。受工作记忆和认知科学中“保留”与“选择性读取”区分的启发，我们提出了LATER，一个基于CF-JEPA构建的动作条件世界模型。LATER将已完成的真实状态转移存储在分区的记忆中，这些记忆在候选推演过程中保持固定不变。一个响应桥利用当前状态和候选动作查询这些记忆，同时多切割辅助监督用于训练记忆写入器。在受干扰的两阶段PushT任务上，与重构的CF-JEPA相比，LATER将最终成功率从15.5%提升至25.0%。在另一项涵盖六个模型和两个从零训练随机种子的对比实验中，LATER在干净视图和受干扰视图下均取得了最低的平均物理读取误差，在干扰物存在的条件下将沿推方向的平均绝对误差（MAE）降低了20.2%。
tldr: LATER提出了一种基于CF-JEPA的动作条件世界模型，通过将早期真实转移存储于分区记忆并在推演时根据状态-动作对进行选择性读取，在受干扰的PushT任务中将成功率从15.5%提升至25.0%，并将干扰条件下的沿推方向MAE降低20.2%。
en_tdlr: LATER is an action-conditioned world model built on CF-JEPA that stores completed real transitions in partitioned memories and selectively reads them out via state-action queries, raising terminal success from 15.5% to 25.0% on distracted PushT tasks and reducing along-push MAE under distractors by 20.2%.
